function.name: boardgame_calculate_score
function.description: Calculate final scores for a board game given a list of player actions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

action.description: Action performed by the player. Possible values are: 'buy property', 'sell property', 'pass go', 'pay fine'.

property_id.description: Unique identifier for each property in the game.

score.description: Initial score of the player. Defaults to 0 if not provided.
